# Waste2Resource

> Australian engineering-led knowledge hub for tailings reuse, mine-waste valorisation and circular infrastructure.

## Core pages
- [Technical Library](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/): 30 source-linked case records with maturity and uncertainty.
- [Assessment Framework](https://waste2resource.com.au/assessment-framework/): site-specific decision path.
- [Research](https://waste2resource.com.au/research/): research summaries and evidence landscape.
- [Business Case](https://waste2resource.com.au/business-case/): value, cost, risk and closure screening.
- [Evidence Methodology](https://waste2resource.com.au/methodology/): editorial and maturity method.
- [About](https://waste2resource.com.au/about/): purpose, independence and scope.

## Case records
- [Plombières tailings in facing bricks](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/plombieres-bricks/): Untreated historic tailings were incorporated into facing-brick blends and assessed for product quality, environmental performance and lifecycle impacts.
- [Nador iron tailings in fired clay bricks](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/nador-fired-bricks/): Iron-mine tailings from an inactive operation were evaluated as an additive in red-clay fired bricks.
- [Pamaka cement–tailings masonry bricks](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/pamaka-bricks/): Artisanal gold-mining waste was tested in cement-bound bricks intended for non-loadbearing masonry.
- [Southern Ecuador gold tailings in concrete blocks](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/ecuador-blocks/): Gold tailings were assessed as a partial sand substitute in concrete-block manufacture.
- [WA iron-ore tailings geopolymer bricks](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/wa-geopolymer-bricks/): Western Australian iron-ore tailings were used as the principal feedstock in alkali-activated geopolymer bricks.
- [Mina do Pico tailings block factory](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/pico-block-factory/): Vale commissioned a pilot factory designed to convert sandy iron-ore tailings into pavers, concrete blocks and other precast products.
- [Donimalai iron tailings masonry units](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/donimalai-bricks/): Donimalai tailings were tested with cement, sand and sodium silicate in brick formulations.
- [WA tailings and waste rock in mine shotcrete](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/wa-shotcrete/): A University of Western Australia programme is investigating mine wastes as aggregate and partial binder inputs for underground shotcrete.
- [Shuangqi gold tailings glass-ceramics](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/shuangqi-glass-ceramic/): Gold tailings were used at high content in dense glass-ceramics produced through controlled heat treatment.
- [Spodumene tailings in building ceramics](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/finland-lithium-ceramics/): Quartz–feldspar tailings and waste glass wool were co-processed into high-performance ceramic specimens.
- [Century zinc tailings retreatment](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/century-zinc/): A large-scale hydraulic mining and flotation operation recovers zinc from the former Century Mine tailings deposit.
- [Mount Morgan tailings processing and rehabilitation](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/mount-morgan/): The project is designed to recover value from historic tailings while funding rehabilitation of a major legacy mine site.
- [Hellyer polymetallic tailings reprocessing](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/hellyer/): The Hellyer facility has reprocessed legacy polymetallic tailings to produce precious- and base-metal concentrates.
- [Ergo gold tailings retreatment](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/ergo/): Historic Witwatersrand tailings are reclaimed and treated through a large surface gold-recovery network.
- [El Teniente tailings copper recovery](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/mvc-chile/): Minera Valle Central recovers copper and molybdenum from fresh El Teniente tailings and historic deposits.
- [Missouri cobalt and nickel tailings recovery](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/missouri-cobalt/): Legacy tailings were evaluated and reprocessed for cobalt-bearing and nickel-bearing concentrates alongside closure works.
- [Pine Creek secondary critical-mineral prospectivity](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/pine-creek-miwatch/): Government-led sampling is assessing historic Pine Creek wastes as potential secondary resources for critical and precious metals.
- [Kunwarara tailings to magnesium feedstock](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/kunwarara-magnesium/): QMAG is characterising fine tailings for fractions suitable for high-purity magnesium chloride and magnesium-metal production.
- [Kidston direct tailings revegetation](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/kidston-revegetation/): Field work assessed whether the tailings surface could support vegetation directly without a conventional soil cap.
- [Sudbury amended-tailings Technosols](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/sudbury-technosol/): Mine residuals were blended with pulp-and-paper residues and forest humus to create plant-growth substrates.
- [Fine-coal tailings Technosols](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/coal-technosol-sa/): Fine coal wastes and organic amendments were evaluated as engineered soils for mine-site rehabilitation.
- [Wheal Jane mine-water treatment](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/wheal-jane/): A long-running active scheme manages high-flow contaminated water from the former mine after passive pilot trials.
- [Tailings-derived media for nickel-mine seepage treatment](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/finland-reactive-barrier/): Alkali-activated material containing mine tailings and zeolite was tested in a permeable reactive barrier treating seepage water.
- [Mount Keith nickel-tailings carbonation](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/mount-keith-carbon/): Weathering of reactive ultramafic tailings forms stable carbonate minerals, with field programmes examining acceleration and verification.
- [Crawford in-process tailings carbonation](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/crawford-carbonation/): A pilot programme is integrating CO₂ mineralisation into the proposed nickel process and tailings circuit.
- [SCO2UT ultramafic-tailings field research](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/sco2ut-canada/): A multi-site programme investigates accelerated carbon mineralisation and verification methods across different residues and climates.
- [Iron tailings in an experimental pavement section](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/brazil-road-section/): Tailings, waste rock and iron-ore canga were placed in base and sub-base mixtures in a monitored experimental road section.
- [Tanami gold-tailings cemented paste backfill](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/tanami-paste-backfill/): Dry excavated tailings are conditioned and pumped underground as cemented paste backfill at the Tanami gold operation.
- [Bowen Basin coal-tailings critical-mineral study](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/bowen-coal-critical-minerals/): A regional programme is examining rare earths, vanadium and broader value-recovery options in coal mine tailings across the Bowen Basin.
- [NSW mine-waste critical-mineral characterisation](https://waste2resource.com.au/technical-library/cases/nsw-mine-reuse/): More than 1,200 samples from 28 mine sites and one power-station site were screened for critical minerals and high-tech metals.

Content is informational and does not replace site investigation, approvals or engineering advice.
